 Vantive US Healthcare LLC (“Vantive”) is the manufacturer and sole source provider in the United States for the Prismax Dialysis Equipment.  Vantive has proprietary rights to the software on the Prismax Dialysis Equipment. Vantive does not contract with any third-party service providers to service the Equipment. located at Naval Medical Center San Diego CA 92134. 

 Based on the approved Justification and Approval (J&A) (which will be posted after award), the agency has identified only one responsible source, and no other supplier will satisfy agency requirements. 

 A determination by the government not to compete based upon responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the government. However, all responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. The applicable NAICS Code is 811210 and the business size standard is 34 (millions of dollars). 

 The point of contact for this announcement is Jojie N. Urrete 

 Be advised that the aforementioned information is anticipatory in nature and is not binding. A copy of the Request for Quote will be made available upon request. Any comments, questions or concerns regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to jojie.n.urrete.civ@health.mil by 19 November 2026 at 08:00 AM PST. Questions by phone or fax will not be considered.
